title: Single button press with ambient colour flare
summary: A prompt bar with one dark pill button idles on a pale drifting gradient; a cursor glides in, presses with a squash, the sparkle icon collapses and the whole background flares saturated blue-violet, then slowly calms.
use_when: The press of one AI action button is the moment to sell
A short vertical loop for a feature page or social post with no copy beyond the button label
An insert between a prompt-typing shot and the result shot of a longer film
Calm, premium product voice where a colour shift replaces a loud effect

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, medium, sentence case, normal tracking, button label ~2.6 % H in white on a near-black pill

sfx.event: background flares saturated after the press

structure.shot: prompt bar cropped off the left edge at ~48 % H, dark pill button with sparkle icon and one-word label; pale blue-lilac gradient
structure.camera: static framing; only the background gradient drifts (blobs shift ~0.25 frame width over 2 s)
structure.motion: button idle, no movement; gradient blobs drift easings.inOutSine over 60 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: arrow cursor glides in from bottom right and parks on the button's right end
structure.motion: cursor enters f61, arrives f64, settles f66: springs.ui ~5 fr, no overshoot visible at 30 fps; button hover nudge ~1 %

structure.shot: button presses, sparkle icon shrinks to one star and vanishes; background floods saturated blue to violet
structure.motion: press f78: springs.click, width -4 % for ~5 fr then back; sparkle collapses f84-f95 easings.outQuint 11 fr; background saturates f83-f88 easings.outExpo 5 fr; cursor fades f91-f106 easings.linear 15 fr

structure.shot: button rests in its done state, label only, no icon; background slowly fades back to the pale opening gradient
structure.motion: button static; gradient desaturates and drifts back from 4.27 to 6.00 s, easings.inOutSine ~52 fr (±0.25 s), holds pale to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: bg and accent drive the two gradient states, fg for the button pill
params.content.label: button label, one or two words
params.content.icon: icon in the button that collapses on press (default sparkle)
params.aspect: 9:16 default; 1:1 and 4:5 recompose with the bar at ~48 % H
params.timing.flare: frames the saturated state holds before calming (default 40)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts, silent. Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 2-4 s: cursor in f61-f66, press f78, background flare f83-f88, icon gone f95, cursor gone f106. No loading spinner is visible: the done state is the icon removal plus the colour flare. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): button-state-press, ambient-flare. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
